description: A valid intentConfig with an appearance font that is not bundled. iOS reports "Invalid configuration" through embeddedPaymentElementLoadingFailed and resolves; Android's view manager throws while parsing the configuration prop.

android.thrown: PaymentSheetAppearanceException: Encountered an error when setting a custom font: Failed to find font: NotABundledFont

parityGaps.result: G10: iOS resolves after reporting the failure; Android has no promise on this path.
parityGaps.events.loadingFailed.message: G10: iOS reports the failure as an event; Android throws instead.
parityGaps.thrown: G10: Android's parseElementConfiguration surfaces the Stripe SDK PaymentSheetAppearanceException text; iOS reports `Invalid configuration` through embeddedPaymentElementLoadingFailed.

unasserted.configuration.merchantDisplayName: The unknown font fails the configuration mapper, so neither SDK returns a configuration that could hold the name.
unasserted.intentConfig.mode.type: The builder consumes mode.type to choose payment or setup. Native code asserts the resulting mode, not this discriminator.
unasserted.intentConfig.mode.captureMethod: The unknown font fails the configuration mapper before captureMethod is observed.
